highlights: Green Lion GLM Wireless Microphone Lite - Black
The Green Lion GLM Wireless Microphone Lite in Black is a compact and powerful tool for high-quality audio recording.
This flexible system comes with two microphones and one receiver.
You can use the transmitter for up to 7 hours. You can extend its life to 21 hours by using the 800mAh charging case.
The transmitter has a 100mAh battery capacity. This microphone ensures stable, interference-free transmission.
It works at up to 20 meters using the 2.4GHz digital frequency. The 48kHz sampling frequency and the 20Hz–20kHz frequency response ensures great sound quality.
They perfectly record every detail. It is great for work situations like presentations and interviews because It has 360° pickup and gives full audio coverage.
The microphone is small and lightweight, making it easy to carry around even with its advanced functions.
The Green Lion GLM Wireless Microphone Lite is perfect for audio recording needs. It blends new technology with portability.
